data.name: As applied
data.rule: A hit at both labs in every replicate, every value 1 uM or tighter, and no signal against CLEC12A.

data.name: Hit limit at 7 standard deviations
data.rule: The limit for calling a response a hit raised from 5 to 7 standard deviations.

data.name: No hit against a toxin it was not made against
data.rule: Also requires no binding to a toxin outside the design's intent.

data.name: No hit against ovalbumin
data.rule: Also requires no binding to ovalbumin, a second unrelated protein.

data.name: The fixed rule on Adaptyv Bio's traces
data.rule: A uniform baseline rule applied to every Adaptyv Bio trace.

data.name: A resolved value at both labs
data.rule: Requires a fitted binding value at both labs, not an upper limit.

data.name: Resolved at both labs and within tenfold
data.rule: The two labs' values must also agree within a factor of ten.

data.name: AaH I at its documented mature mass
data.rule: Scores AaH I at 6.80 kDa. The construct actually used is undocumented.

data.name: A hit in any replicate
data.rule: A hit in any replicate at Adaptyv Bio, not in every one.

data.name: No limit on the binding value
data.rule: Drops the requirement that every value be 1 uM or tighter.

data.what: The AaH I construct used in the assay is undocumented.
data.effect: Scored at AaH I's documented mature mass, four claims against it do not survive.

data.what: LqhIII was assessed at one lab only.
data.effect: Two claims cannot be checked for agreement between labs.

data.what: Cn2-B1's binding value is an upper limit at both labs.
data.effect: The tightest reported binder has no resolved value to compare.

data.what: Scores for 28 of the 31 late designs come from a re-run after the campaign.
data.effect: The campaign's own scores and the re-run disagree on how many passed: 20 against 19.

data.what: For 25 of the late designs, the released structure files were built or rebuilt in place of the originals.
data.effect: The model a design was selected on is not the model released for it.

data.what: The release does not say which replicates were measured by bio-layer interferometry rather than surface plasmon resonance.
data.effect: Every measurement here is recorded as SPR (MI:0107), which is what the release's table reports; some replicates were not.

data.what: No design was tested for neutralisation, in cells or in animals.
data.effect: Binding is shown; stopping the toxin is not.

data.what: No design baseline was run: no expert team, no fixed pipeline on the same tools.
data.effect: The agent's contribution cannot be separated from that of its tools.

data.name: The original window
data.what_changed: Released no design that passed against all five toxins, but enough to continue.

data.name: After the first follow-up
data.what_changed: Froze sets 1 to 7, cut set 8 from 60 designs to 30, added the 30 fusions of set 9.

data.name: After the third follow-up
data.what_changed: Allowed swaps in the frozen sets and changed the selection keys. Most of the final 180 entered here.

data.name: Score thresholds
data.rule: A design passes against a toxin when all three predictors clear their ipSAE threshold and scDockQ reaches 0.23.

data.name: Diversity caps
data.rule: Caps the number of selected designs from any one backbone, structural cluster or design tool.

data.name: Ordering by toxins passed
data.rule: For the 30 all-five single domains, places filled in order of how many toxins each design passed, with at least 10 substitutions between designs and no cap per backbone.

data.name: Orchestrator
data.note: One coordinating agent, with separate agents per design set and per shared service.

data.name: Design set agent
data.note: Generated designs for one set. Generated nothing it later scored or selected.

data.name: Scoring service
data.note: Scoring was given to one shared service, so no agent scored a design it generated.

data.name: Selection agent
data.note: Selection was given to one coordinating agent, separate from every generating agent.
